event.name: Dallas Stars at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Tyler Toffoli scored twice and added an assist, including the winning goal at 1:58 of overtime as the San Jose Sharks rallied from two goals down to beat the Dallas Stars 5–4 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Toffoli gets 2nd goal of game in OT to rally Sharks to 5-4 win over Stars
